method: Installed image tool generated isolated pigment on white. White discarded; selected strokes mapped to ochre and charcoal and blended onto exact inherited stone.
visual_review: Inspected full PNG and 512px JPEG: recognizable inherited Pepe, wide mouth, heavy-lidded eyes and both five-digit hands preserved. Four fingers and one thumb counted on each; no new hands added. No writing, logos, borders, real people or prohibited symbols observed. Prior marks, rock, framing and lighting retained.
unmet_visual_requirements: Inherited rock texture remains photographic in detail; retained to preserve the existing wall.
limitations: Fine sieve mesh and stones soften in the 512px JPEG.
Local visual and byte checks are observations, not independent certification.
